svg.desc: Lexical spectrum. How many corpus types occur once, twice, or at each higher frequency?. hapax 1,200 · dislegomena 360 · 30 observed frequencies. Every point is an exact integer-frequency class; logarithmic axes do not turn the points into intervals.
